messages:
elaine: Quick design question — in the regression diff list, people keep asking how to know which diffs can be merged automatically. proposing a small "Merge priority" affordance that marks diffs as 'auto-merge candidate' based on eval pass rate and unchanged scorecard expectations. thoughts? michael: Love the idea. We should be careful about the label wording. 'Auto-merge' might sound too final. Maybe 'merge candidate' or 'suggested merge' so humans still review. devin: +1 to softer language. Also we need an obvious keyboard focus state. People use keyboard nav in big eval runs. elaine: Good point. 'Suggested merge' then. UX questions: placement (left of diff header vs inline CTA), visibility density, and color contrast for the tag. lina: Placement: left of header seems consistent with other status tags. But if it's too prominent it could bias reviewers to accept. Maybe secondary tone (neutral background, 1px outline) and a tooltip that explains criteria. michael: Tooltip copy suggestion: "Suggested merge — passes threshold for stability and scorecard expectations. Still requires human approval." short and scannable. elaine: Accessibility nit: ensure the tag has accessible name and role so screen readers can announce why it's suggested. Also tooltip must be keyboard accessible. @a11y-bot any suggestions? a11y-bot: Recommend using an aria-describedby relationship from the tag to the tooltip content and ensuring tooltip appears on focus. Example: ```html
Pass rate >= 95% and no score regressions
``` Also ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small text. devin: Thanks — I can add that pattern. Another thing: batch behavior. Some reviewers want to filter to only suggested merges and bulk-approve. We need a confirmation affordance that shows the number of diffs, and highlights any edge-case diffs that were flagged but still suggested. lina: UX for bulk confirm: Modal with two columns. Left = list, right = sampling preview of selected diff changes + scorecard summary. CTA copy: 'Approve selected' vs 'Approve suggested' — prefer 'Approve selected' to avoid implying we auto-picked decisions. michael: Keep the primary CTA action-focused: 'Approve selected (X)'. Secondary small link for 'View acceptance criteria'. elaine: Minor copy tweak proposal for the per-diff microcopy (below the tag): "Criteria met: pass rate, no failing assertions" -> shorter: "Criteria met: stable & no regressions" a11y-bot: For screen reader clarity, keep the tooltip message slightly longer than visible label. Provide both: visible short text and aria-describedby with detailed reason. devin: One more keyboard flow: when filtering to 'Suggested merges' and tabbing into the list, hitting space on a diff should open the detail modal. People expect space/Enter to open. lina: Agree. Also we should add an unobtrusive inline keyboard hint (small text) only visible on hover/focus: "Press Space to open". Ensure it's not relied on for discoverability. michael: Design ask: can we include the suggested merge confidence score (e.g., 97%) as a hover-only element? If yes, accessibility note: that number must be in the tooltip text for SRs. elaine: OK action items: 1) design mock for tag styles + modal flow (lina) 2) copy options for tooltip + modal CTAs (michael) 3) keyboard + aria pattern implementation snippet (devin) 4) add a short accessibility test case to eval-run checklist (a11y-bot) lina: I'll sketch mocks today and post in thread. leaning neutral tag + outline, tooltip on focus, small 'Press Space to open' hint. michael: I'll draft two copy variants: conservative and plain. Posting in 30m. devin: I'll prototype the aria-describedby pattern and keyboard handlers. Will include example tests. elaine: Thanks — if we can keep the bulk-approve modal to a single-step confirm with clear sampling preview, product can ship this as experimental flag for a subset of runs. :thumbsup: michael: One more: analytics event names we should log: suggested_merge_shown, suggested_merge_bulk_approve, suggested_merge_override. cc @product-analytics elaine: noted. we'll coordinate with analytics after design mock. lina: mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/links/mock-merge-candidate (feedback welcome) michael: seen, leaving comments on the mock now. devin: will sync with eng on API flags and the rule threshold config. maybe make threshold configurable per org. elaine: Perfect. Closing out here. If anyone thinks the label still reads too strong swap to 'Review suggested'. Otherwise we'll iterate on copy after initial rollout. :rocket:
